lines.japanese: 「くっ……つ、う……ふぁっ……」
lines.english: “Ugh... ngh... ah...”

lines.japanese: 朝の満員電車、今日も私はいつもの車両で、先輩のお姿を拝見できるベストポジションを死守していました。
lines.english: On the packed morning train, I was once again defending the ideal position in my usual car from which to gaze upon Haneda.

lines.japanese: はい、ここまでは普段と変わらぬルーチンワークですが、しかしこの先は違います。違ってみせます。
lines.english: Yes, up to this point it was the same routine as ever. But what came next would be different. I would make it different.

lines.japanese: 私には確たる目標がありました。人間、向かう先がはっきり定まっていれば自然とまぶたも開くというものです。
lines.english: I had a definite goal. When a person knows exactly where she is headed, her eyes naturally open wide.

lines.japanese: くわっ。
lines.english: Wide!

lines.japanese: そうです。今日こそいよいよ林田美咲はその名を告げるのです。私は前へ進むと決めたのです。
lines.english: That was right. Today, at long last, Misaki Hayashida would tell him her name. I had resolved to move forward.

lines.japanese: だけど──
lines.english: But—
“Sigh...”

lines.japanese: ──やっぱり第一声のきっかけが見つかりません。
lines.english: —I still could not find an opening for that first word.

lines.japanese: 羽田先輩はドアに寄りそって漫画雑誌を御覧の様子。
lines.english: Haneda was leaning against the door, apparently reading a manga magazine.

lines.japanese: おそらく知的で繊細な彼のお好みは、瑞々しい心情描写で綴られた人間ドラマか、現代社会の矛盾に鋭くメスを入れた職業ものあたりだと思います。
lines.english: A sensitive intellectual like him probably favored human dramas filled with vivid emotional insight, or stories of working life that cut incisively into the contradictions of modern society.

lines.japanese: ともあれ、よほど作品世界に没頭しているようで、食いいるように深く首を折っておられます。
lines.english: Whatever it was, he seemed completely immersed in its world, his head bent so low that he practically devoured the pages.

lines.japanese: せめて、せめて目と目がぶつかり合えば、軽く会釈も出来ようものを……！
lines.english: If only—if only our eyes would meet, I could at least give him a little nod...!

lines.japanese: ああ先輩、少しはこちらを見てください。
lines.english: Oh, Haneda, please look this way.

lines.japanese: 私はここにいます。私に気付いてください。
lines.english: I am right here. Please notice me.

lines.japanese: 私の視線、感じていただけませんでしょうか。
lines.english: Can you not feel my gaze upon you?

lines.japanese: お願い、届いてこの想い。
lines.english: Please, let these feelings reach him.

lines.japanese: くわっ。
lines.english: Wide!

lines.japanese: 不意に先輩が、身震いしながらお顔を上げられました。
lines.english: Without warning, Haneda shuddered and raised his head.

lines.japanese: 偶然と呼ぶには出来過ぎたタイミング。これはやはり恋の祈りが通じたのかもしれませ──
lines.english: The timing was too perfect to be mere coincidence. Perhaps my lovesick prayer truly had reached—

lines.japanese: 「どぅおおおーっ！」
lines.english: “Gwaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「ひゃあっ！」
lines.english: “Eek!”

lines.japanese: なんということでしょう。不意に電車が揺れ、私は大勢の乗客の皆さんと共に平衡を失ってしまい、そして──
lines.english: Oh, calamity! The train suddenly lurched, robbing me and many of my fellow passengers of our balance, and then—

lines.japanese: ──あろうことか、羽田先輩の胸に肩から突撃してしまったのです！
lines.english: —to my horror, I went hurtling shoulder-first into Haneda’s chest!

lines.japanese: ああ、けれど、私を支えてくださったこの温かい体。この包容力。非常に、非常に申しわけなくは思うのですが、それはそれとして。
lines.english: Oh, but the warm body that caught me. The security of his embrace. I was deeply, deeply sorry, but that was one matter, and this was another.

lines.japanese: しゃーわせー……
lines.english: So haaappy...

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫？」
lines.english: “Are you all right?”

lines.japanese: 気付けば夢にまで見たあの声。
lines.english: Before I knew it, I heard the voice that visited even my dreams.

lines.japanese: 「あ！　いえ！　すみませんっ！」
lines.english: “Oh! Yes! I’m sorry!”

lines.japanese: 私は飛びのく勢いで先輩から離れました。むしろ非常用ドアコックを引いて「うああああ」と叫びながら飛びだしたい心境でした。
lines.english: I sprang away from Haneda. In fact, I felt like pulling the emergency door release and leaping from the train with a scream.

lines.japanese: 「具合でも悪いの？」
lines.english: “Are you feeling sick?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いえ、その、へーきです……」
lines.english: “N-no, um, I’m fine...”

lines.japanese: 羽田先輩がせっかく見知らぬ女生徒Ａの身を案じてくださっていると言うのに、私ときたら、目も合わせられずにもごもごと口ごもる始末。
lines.english: Haneda had gone to the trouble of expressing concern for an unknown Schoolgirl A, and there I was, unable to meet his eyes, doing nothing but mumble.

lines.japanese: 「そう。よかった」
lines.english: “Okay. Good.”

lines.japanese: ご心配ありがとうございます。
lines.english: Thank you for worrying about me.

lines.japanese: こちらこそ失礼いたしました。
lines.english: And I apologize for the trouble.

lines.japanese: 雑誌は大丈夫でしたか。
lines.english: Was your magazine all right?

lines.japanese: なんという漫画を読んでいたんですか。
lines.english: What manga were you reading?

lines.japanese: 私が好きな漫画もありますよ。
lines.english: There’s a manga I like too.

lines.japanese: ええ、とっても面白いんです。
lines.english: Yes, it’s very good.

lines.japanese: こんどお貸ししましょうか。
lines.english: Would you like to borrow it sometime?

lines.japanese: はい、それでは明日持ってきます。
lines.english: Certainly. I’ll bring it tomorrow.

lines.japanese: また明日、この車両、この時間に──
lines.english: I’ll see you tomorrow, in this car at this time—

lines.japanese: ──不思議です。瞬きほどのあいだにここまでシミュレート出来るのに、どうして実際はなにも言えないのでしょう。
lines.english: —how strange. I could simulate such an extensive conversation in the blink of an eye, so why could I say none of it in reality?

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、雑誌……」
lines.english: “Um... Your magazine...”

lines.japanese: 終点までの十数分、何度か口を開きかけはしたのです。
lines.english: During the dozen-odd minutes until the last stop, I tried to speak several times.

lines.japanese: しかし電車の駆動音に勝てるほどの声が出せず、けっきょくすごすごと唇を丸めこんでしまうのでした。
lines.english: But I could not make myself heard over the rumble of the train, and each time I meekly pressed my lips shut again.

lines.japanese: 進めない私を乗せて電車は進みます。
lines.english: The train moved forward, carrying me, who could not.

lines.japanese: タマちゃん、私また変われなかったよ。
lines.english: Tama, I failed to change again.

lines.japanese: けれど想像の中のタマちゃんは許してくれませんでした。
lines.english: But the Tama in my imagination would not forgive me.

lines.japanese: 彼女は何かに頬杖をついた姿勢で、じっと私を睨んでいるのです。あっ、顎でくいっと促されてしまいました。
lines.english: She had her cheek propped on one hand and was staring straight at me. Oh! Now she was urging me on with a little jerk of her chin.

lines.japanese: うん、分かったよタマちゃん。ありがとう。私、行ってくる！
lines.english: Okay, Tama, I understand. Thank you. I’m going!

lines.japanese: 前をゆく無数の背中に紛れた、私にとってただひとつの背中。ひとごみを掻きわけて突きすすみ──
lines.english: Among the countless backs moving ahead, there was only one back in the world for me. I forced my way through the crowd—

lines.japanese: 「わわっ……すみません……あの、ちょ、前に……行かせて、くださ……あああ～」
lines.english: “Wah... Excuse me... I need to... get through... Aaah...”

lines.japanese: ──だいぶ難儀はしましたが、ともかく突きすすみ、ついに私はその背中へ辿りついたのです。
lines.english: —it was a considerable struggle, but I pressed onward all the same, and at last reached that back.

lines.japanese: 「先輩！」
lines.english: “Excuse me!”

lines.japanese: しかし群衆の喧騒にまみれて声は届かず、ああ、彼の足は止まってくれませんでした。
lines.english: But the clamor of the crowd swallowed my voice, and alas, his feet did not stop.

lines.japanese: あるいは朝から哲学的思考に耽っていて、世俗の音など通りぬけてしまうのかもしれません。
lines.english: Or perhaps he was already lost in philosophical reflection so early in the morning, and the sounds of the mundane world simply passed through him.

lines.japanese: いままでの私ならここで打ちのめされ、ただ立ちつくしたまま恋愛の神様を呪うだけだったでしょう。
lines.english: The old me would have been crushed, left standing there with nothing to do but curse the god of love.

lines.japanese: しかし今日からの私は違います。
lines.english: But as of today, I was different.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのっ！」
lines.english: “E-excuse me!”

lines.japanese: こぶしを握り、図々しくも先輩の行く手に立たせていただきました。
lines.english: Clenching my fists, I had the audacity to plant myself directly in Haneda’s path.

lines.japanese: 「２Ｂの林田美咲と申します！　先程は失礼いたしました！」
lines.english: “My name is Misaki Hayashida, from Class 2-B! I apologize for what happened earlier!”

lines.japanese: 勢いまかせに名乗ったあとは、赤くなった顔を隠すために深々と頭を下げてしまいます。
lines.english: Once I had introduced myself on pure momentum, I bowed deeply to hide my burning face.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、さっきの。いいよ、そんな」
lines.english: “Oh, you’re the girl from before. It’s fine, really.”

lines.japanese: 「いえっ！　ほんとに！　すみませんでした！」
lines.english: “No! Truly! I’m very sorry!”

lines.japanese: 両脇にぴったり手を付けて軍人さんみたいに謝る私は、きっと不自然だったことでしょう。
lines.english: With my hands pinned straight to my sides as I apologized like a soldier, I must have looked quite unnatural.

lines.japanese: 我ながら大袈裟だとは思うのですが、しかしいざ先輩の前にたつと思考がパァーッとなって、無意識のうちに声も動作も大きくなってしまうのです。
lines.english: Even I knew I was being melodramatic, but the instant I stood before Haneda, my mind went completely blank, and my voice and movements grew exaggerated of their own accord.

lines.japanese: 「それではっ！」
lines.english: “Goodbye!”

lines.japanese: のぼせた頭では何も考えることが出来ず、気付けば私は先輩の前から逃げだしていました。
lines.english: My overheated brain could form no further thoughts, and before I knew it, I was fleeing from him.

lines.japanese: 「ああああ～……！　言っちゃった恥ずかしい恥ずかしい恥ずかしいっ……！」
lines.english: “Aaaah...! I said it! That was so embarrassing, so embarrassing, so embarrassing...!”

lines.japanese: 紅潮する頬を両手で冷やしながら、しかし混雑した朝の駅舎内では逃げることもままならず、私は群衆の中しゃかしゃか足踏みするように速歩きしていました。
lines.english: I cooled my flushed cheeks with both hands. Since I could scarcely run through the crowded station that morning, I hurried away through the throng with tiny, churning steps.

lines.japanese: タマちゃん、どうしよう！　私ついに言っちゃったよ！
lines.english: Tama, what am I going to do? I finally told him!

lines.japanese: 先輩に名前言っちゃったよ！　挙動不審の女生徒Ａを卒業しちゃったよ！
lines.english: I told Haneda my name! I graduated from being Suspicious Schoolgirl A!

lines.japanese: 「はぁー……はぁー……」
lines.english: “Haaah... Haaah...”

lines.japanese: 口元を隠して、小さく深呼吸してみました。胸の鼓動が収まりません。
lines.english: I covered my mouth and tried taking several small, deep breaths. My heart refused to settle down.

lines.japanese: しかしそれは、さっきまでの胃がねじれるようなどきどきと違って、とても心地よい力の湧きでてくるようなどきどきだったのです。
lines.english: But this was different from the stomach-twisting pounding I had felt moments ago. This pounding was wonderfully pleasant, as though strength were welling up inside me.

lines.japanese: 「はぁー、はぁー」
lines.english: “Haaah... Haaah...”

lines.japanese: 先輩どう思ったかな。私ヘンな名前って思われなかったかな。
lines.english: I wondered what Haneda thought. I hoped he did not find my name strange.

lines.japanese: どんな字で書くんだろうって考えたりしてくれてるかな。
lines.english: Was he wondering how to spell it?

lines.japanese: いつまでも忘れないで覚えていてくれるかな。
lines.english: Would he remember it forever and never forget?

lines.japanese: どうしても気になって、そろーっと後ろを振りかえってみました。
lines.english: Unable to resist, I timidly looked back over my shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「ひっ！」
lines.english: “Eep!”

lines.japanese: 意地悪な偶然。先輩と目が合ってしまいました。
lines.english: By some cruel coincidence, my eyes met Haneda’s.

lines.japanese: 「えへへ……」
lines.english: “Eheh...”

lines.japanese: なんとなく笑ってごまかしたあとは、今度こそ振りかえらず、ばびゅんと逃げだしました。
lines.english: I covered for myself with a vague little laugh, then shot away at full speed without looking back again.

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ……くすくす……うふふふ……」
lines.english: “Hee-hee... Tee-hee... Ehehehe...”

lines.japanese: けれど、笑いだしたら止まりませんでした。
lines.english: But once I started laughing, I could not stop.
